The 2006 records under this author are 'El efecto del empleo, el paro y los contratos temporales en la baja fecundidad española' (10.2307/40184772), which is C.5.a's subject, and an unindexed UPF working paper on education enrolment and first-birth timing. Recorded as UNRESOLVED, NOT as absent: it may be a book chapter or a working paper outside the index, or a mis-citation in the master list. Flag for TICK-001 (PI review of HYPOTHESES) either way. NOTE: the unaccented spelling 'Baizan' returns 2 records and the accented 'Baizán' returns 362 -- the unaccented query would have produced a confident false negative.
